player_prompt.intro:
O Modiri {player_id} ({role}) mo maemong a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies.
- Ka ngwaga wa kgwedi, ka tsweletse [heads] kgotsa [tails] (kgotsa [h], [t]).
- Fa o le kgatlhanong le tshono ya modiri wa gago, Modiri 0 a fenya kgwedi; kgotsa Modiri 1 a fenya.
Araba le tshono ya gago ka tsela '[heads]' kgotsa '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsela e si sa tlwaelesegile; ka tsweletse '[heads]' kgotsa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wins
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 wins.

outcome.p0_wins: Motshameki 0 o ne a fenya metshameko e le mentsi.
outcome.p1_wins: Motshameki wa ntlha o ne a fenya metshameko e le mentsi.
